LanguageData.Yuudong2.Settings.RestartNote: Changes take effect after restarting the game.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Settings.RestartPending: Settings changed. Restart the game to apply them.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.NoBreakup.Desc: Blocks the vanilla breakup, broken engagement and divorce paths.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.SameBedLovin.Desc: Pawns lying in the same shared bed can do lovin without a romantic relationship.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.ShelfNoSlowdown.Desc: Shelves and small shelves no longer slow movement, and drafted pawns can stand on them.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.ShelfAcceptAll.Desc: Shelves and small shelves can hold everything a stockpile can (including chunks, plants, packaged furniture, wastepacks and large corpses). Pick what they take in the shelf's storage settings.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.HealthCardSorting.Desc: Within each body part, lists non-injury entries first and injuries after, both sorted by name.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.MessagePlacement.Desc: Moves on-screen messages below the colonist bar. (Better Message Placement)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.NoMapEdgeLimit.Desc: Allows building and zoning at the map edge. (Change map edge limit)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.PowerOnDemand.Desc: Workbenches, TVs, research benches and similar buildings draw full power only while in use and 1 W while idle. (Turn It On and Off)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.DurableClothes.Desc: Daily wear on worn apparel drops to 5% of vanilla. (Durable Clothes)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.InfiniteApparelDurabili: Keeps apparel worn by player pawns at full hit points. (Infinite apparel durability)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.AllSpecialistsCanWork.D: Ideoligion roles no longer disable work types or weapons. (All Specialists Can Work)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.FasterBiosculpter.Desc: All biosculpter pod cycles take 1 day and biotuning does not persist. (Faster Biosculpter Pod)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.CaravanArrivalSpot.Desc: Enables the caravan arrival spot in Architect > Misc. Trader caravans enter from the nearest map edge and wait at the spot.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.TradeShipDropSpot.Desc: Enables the supply drop spot in Architect > Misc. Drop pods with orbital trade goods, quest rewards, royal aid and returning colonists land near it. Enemy raids are not affected. (Formerly the trade ship drop spot)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.TradeStockBoost.Desc: Orbital, settlement and caravan traders get 8x stock and silver. Visitor traders are unchanged. (Trading Options)
Orbital traders come 4x as often under storytellers that use random incidents, such as Randy. (Trading Options)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.InsultFaction.Desc: Adds an insult option to comms console faction dialogs. Insulting a hostile faction brings a raid in 1 to 7 hours. (Raids For Me)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.EpoeAiCore.Desc: With EPOE-Forked, removes the AI persona core's maintenance and AI issues and keeps only its best-state bonuses.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.DragonianGenes.Desc: With the Dragonian race mod, removes the dragonborn genes' exclusivity limits.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.DragonianHealing.Desc: On load, re-enables dragonborn genes that were overridden by wound healing genes. (Dragonian to Super Fast Healing Patch)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.HairUnderHats.Desc: Keeps hair visible under headgear and draws headgear above hair, including modded races and hats. Detail settings apply immediately. (Replaces Show Hair With Hats and Dubs Apparel Tweaks)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.CustomMapSize.Desc: Lets you set the starting map width and height in the advanced game settings, and pick the default map size in the details. (Better Map Sizes)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.NoIdeologyLimits.Desc: Removes meme, precept and ritual count limits and lets every precept be removed in the editor. (Ducks' No Limits - Ideology)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Hair.UnderUpper.Desc: Draws hair under headgear that covers the upper head.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Hair.UnderFull.Desc: Draws hair under headgear that covers the full head.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Hair.BeardUnderFull.Desc: Draws beards under headgear that covers the full head.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Hair.AboveHair.Desc: If a hat would be drawn below the hair, moves it just above the hair.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Hair.OnlyPlayer.Desc: Applies only to pawns of the player faction; others hide hair as in vanilla.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Hair.Scale.Desc: Enlarges headgear slightly if hair pokes out from under it.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Hair.HairList: Checked hairstyles are hidden under headgear
LanguageData.Yuudong2.MapSize.SettingsDesc: The default map size preselected for new games. Existing saves are not affected.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Ideology.OnlyPlayer.Desc: AI faction ideologies keep the normal limits.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.ReplaceStuff.Desc: Adds a Replace stuff button under Architect > Structure, and building the same thing with another material replaces the material in place without deconstructing. Rooms stay sealed and bills are kept. (Only the stuff replacement part of Replace Stuff)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Replace.Label: Replace stuff
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Replace.Desc: Replaces the material of a building without deconstructing it, e.g. a wooden wall into a granite wall.\n\nClick to choose the material, then drag over the buildings to replace.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Insult.Ally: {0} ({1}) is very disappointed. Relations have worsened.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Insult.RaidDropPod: {0} ({1}) started a drop pod raid on you!
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Insult.RaidDelayed: {0} ({1}) is furious! You will be raided in {2}!
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.NoRandomRelations.Desc: Newly generated pawns get no random family or romantic relations. (No Random Relations)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.RoomFood.Desc: Colonists prefer food stored in a room with a nearby table. (Room Food)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.MeatOptimization.Desc: Merges per-animal meats into raw, human and insect meat. Per-race policy is in the details and needs a restart. (Optimization: Meats)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.SinglePlantTexture.Desc: Draws one plant per cell for crops like rice and haygrass. (Single Plant Texture Patch)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.DamageIndicators.Desc: Shows damage, shield absorption and melee misses as floating numbers. (Damage Indicators)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.LetterStackCleaner.Desc: Clears the letter stack with a key, Delete by default. (Letter stack cleaner)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.SmartSpeed.Desc: Changes speed multipliers, always shows the ultrafast button, and lets you pick event slowdown by right-clicking the time controls. (Smart Speed)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.DragSelect.Desc: Drag across work priorities, copy/paste buttons and trade count buttons to press many at once. (DragSelect)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.HiddenBionicEyes.Desc: Hides bionic and archotech eye graphics on faces. (Hidden Eyes)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.EndlessGrowth.Desc: Removes the skill level 20 cap and adjusts XP, crafting quality and bill ranges. Detail changes need a restart. (EndlessGrowth)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.RolesUntiedToMemes.Desc: Specialist roles no longer require specific memes. (Roles untied to memes)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.AutoCastSpecialistComma: Auto-casts specialist commands when the matching work starts. Right-click a command button to toggle. (Auto-Cast Specialist Commands)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.EmpireGoodwillFix.Desc: Prevents the Empire starting at -100 goodwill in some scenarios. (Empire -100 goodwill in scenarios Fix)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.GloomyFurnitureFix.Desc: Adds extra furniture and fixes when GloomyFurniture (Continued) is active, allows blueprints over wall-mounted furniture, and adds sterile and reinforced walls. Needs a restart. (Gloomy Furniture Fix, MoreGloomyWalls)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.RoomFood.Distance: Distance to look for a table: {0}
LanguageData.Yuudong2.RoomFood.Distance.Desc: If a table in a room with food is within this distance, food in that room is preferred.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Damage.Neutral.Desc: When off, nothing is shown if the attacker or target has no faction.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Damage.PawnsOnly.Desc: Nothing is shown if the target is not a pawn.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Damage.PawnInstigatorOnly.Desc: Damage from non-pawn sources such as decay or fire is not shown.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.AutoCast.Tip: You can also right-click the command buttons in game to toggle auto-cast.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Meat.Note: Leaving the policy on automatic is recommended. Changes need a restart.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Meat.ExistingSaveWarning: Loading an existing save with meat merge newly enabled may cause errors.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Letter.OneAtATime: Clear one letter at a time
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Speed.Note: Right-click the time controls to choose the event slowdown.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Speed.Ultrafast.Desc: Default 15, 900 ticks per second. Limited by what your PC can handle.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Endless.UnlimitedPrice: Allow sell price above buy price
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Endless.BillGap: Gap between your highest skill level and the max in bills (existing bills may need adjusting)
LanguageData.Skill86: God of Transcended Gods of Doom
LanguageData.Skill87: God of Transcended Gods of Doom
LanguageData.Skill88: God of Transcended Gods of Doom
LanguageData.Skill89: God of Transcended Gods of Doom
LanguageData.Skill90: God of Transcended Gods of Doom
LanguageData.Skill96: God of Transcended Gods of Transcended Doom
LanguageData.Skill97: God of Transcended Gods of Transcended Doom
LanguageData.Skill98: God of Transcended Gods of Transcended Doom
LanguageData.Skill99: God of Transcended Gods of Transcended Doom
LanguageData.Skill100: Transcended God of Transcended Gods of Transcended Doom
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.RomanceTweaks.Desc: Multiplies romance attempt, success and breakup chances. Defaults block cheating, cross-faction romance and breakups. (Romance Tweaks)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.RoofedScanning.Desc: Ground-penetrating and long-range mineral scanners can be built and used under roofs. (Roofed Scanning)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.RpgLevelUp.Desc: Pawns level up from skill XP and kills and spend points on six attributes that boost many stats. Manage them in the Level tab; hover an attribute to see its effects and limits. Existing save data carries over. (RPG Style Level Up Mod)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.GeneAssistant.Desc: Colors genes by ownership in the gene assembler and adds a gene library, duplicate genepack ejection, filled slot display and better sorting. (Random's Gene Assistant)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.DragonianMix.Desc: With the Dragonian race mod, adds DragonianMix factions, pawns, abilities, weapons and gases. Turning it off removes its defs, so do not disable it in saves that use them. Needs a restart. (DragonianMix)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Romance.Single.Desc: Applied when both pawns are single.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Romance.Cheating.Desc: Applied when either pawn is with someone else. 0 prevents cheating.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Romance.Faction.Desc: Applied when the pawns belong to different factions.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Romance.Breakup.Desc: Multiplier for breakup chance. 'No breakups' blocks breakups regardless.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Desc.STR: Boosts physical labor and melee attacks.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Desc.DEX: Improves accuracy and work that needs dexterity.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Desc.AGL: Improves movement, dodging and aiming speed.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Desc.CON: Reduces damage taken and improves immunity, rest and temperature tolerance.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Desc.INT: Improves research, medicine, yields, psycasting and mech abilities, and grants more level XP.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Desc.CHA: Improves negotiation, animal handling, conversion and suppression.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Special.Heal: Above {0}, heals a random injury by (CON - 100) × 0.01 every 20 seconds
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Limits: Attributes have no upper limit. Negative values apply the effects in reverse. Effects with a listed minimum or maximum never go beyond it.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.ExpFromSkills: {0}% of skill XP gained (more with intelligence)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.ExpFromKills: {0}% of a killed enemy's combat power
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.NeedExpFormula: XP to next level = 100 × ln(level + 1) × (1 + level × 1%)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.PointsTip: Unspent attribute points. Use the buttons in the attribute columns to spend them. With no points, tick an attribute's box to auto-spend future points there (only one). Points can be refunded down to the starting minimum ({0}).
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.AutoTip: When on, level-up points go into {0} automatically. Only one attribute can be selected.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.DistributeTip:
Spend points
Click: +1
Shift+click: +10
Ctrl+click: +100
Alt+click: refund (with Shift/Ctrl for 10/100, down to the starting minimum {0})
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Reroll: Reroll (god mode): refunds points equal to level and rerolls starting attributes.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.GodPoints: Add points (god mode)\nClick +1, Shift +10, Ctrl +100, Alt reset to 0
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.CategoryTip: Cycles colonists, animals, mechanoids and ghouls.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.TabHint: Hover a row for details. Spend points in the Level tab at the bottom bar.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Set.Flat.Desc: When on, new pawns start with all attributes at 0. When off, they are rolled between the min and max below.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Set.SkillExp.Desc: Share of skill XP that also counts as level XP.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Set.AnimalExp.Desc: Animals have no skills, so they gain XP over time.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Set.KillExp.Desc: XP gained from a kill as a share of the enemy's combat power.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Set.StartMin.Desc: Used when flat starting attributes is off. Refunds also stop at this value.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Set.StartMax.Desc: Used when flat starting attributes is off.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Set.MaxLevel.Desc: Pawns stop leveling at this level.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Set.Scaling: New pawn level scaling: {0}% of colonist average
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rpg.Set.Scaling.Desc: Sets new pawns' (including enemies') level to this share of the colonist average. 0 disables it.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Gene.OverrideSorting.Desc: Sorts genepacks by their most impactful gene instead of the first one.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Gene.Saturation.Desc: Strength of the ownership background colors.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Gene.SellFromBanks.Desc: Lists genepacks stored in gene banks for trade.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Gene.LibraryHint: Pick ignored genes with the gene library button on the gene assembler. Currently ignoring {0}.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Gene.UI.Hide2: Hide fully and partially acquired genes
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Gene.UI.Hide4: Hide fully acquired and ignored genes
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Gene.UI.Hide5: Hide fully, partially acquired and ignored genes
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Gene.UI.Eject.Desc: Ejects duplicate genepacks for selling. Can also eject cosmetic or combined genepacks.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.RealisticRooms.Desc: Lowers the space needed for each room size tier and reduces the indoor beauty penalty of dirt and sand from -15 to -4. (Realistic Rooms Rewritten)
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rooms.Note: Minimum space for each tier. A lower tier cannot exceed the next one. Values ending in .5 are recommended because the game rounds. Changes apply immediately.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Rooms.Filth.Desc: When on, indoor dirt and sand filth has -4 beauty. When off, it returns to the original value (vanilla -15).
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.GloomyWallReplace.Desc: Building a Gloomy wall (vent, window, sterile, reinforced walls, etc.) on an existing wall replaces it in place without deconstructing, keeping the roof and room. Part of the old wall's materials is refunded. Vent walls use the placement rotation, or turn 90 degrees if both sides would be blocked. Requires the stuff replacement feature.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.MapWideTradeBeacon.Desc: While any powered orbital trade beacon exists, orbital trade uses everything in colony storage across the whole map (stockpiles, storage buildings such as shelves, bookcases and outfit stands, gene banks) instead of the beacon radius. Loose items on the ground and forbidden items are excluded. Silver payments come from storage too. The beacon radius is hidden and the beacon costs 10 times as much.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.TradeBeacon.DescNote: (Yuudong2Mod) Trades everything in colony storage across the whole map regardless of range. Loose items on the ground and forbidden items are excluded. One beacon is enough.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.TechprintTradeHighlight: Colors techprint rows in the trade window: green if already researched or the applied and owned techprints are enough, yellow if partly applied or owned, red if none. Hover to see applied and owned counts. Uses the gene assistant colors.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Techprint.Finished: {0}: already researched. This techprint is not needed.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.RatkinDrawScaleFix.Desc: Prevents NewRatkinPlus's gene draw-scale cache from being corrupted by concurrent render threads, which made every pawn invisible. Uses a thread-safe cache for the same calculation. Does nothing without NewRatkinPlus.
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.TpsDisplay.Desc: Shows "TPS : current(target)" above the weather and condition readouts at the bottom right. Current updates once per second and is the ticks actually run in that second; target is the ticks per second for the current speed (60 at normal speed, 0 when paused).
LanguageData.Yuudong2.Feature.BetterWorkbench.Desc: Adds quality, hit point, material and stockpile limits for counted items, extra counted products, counting items on away colonists, bill copy/paste/linking and pawn/workbench restrictions. Unlike the original, away colonists are still counted after loading a save and when they are off-map, such as colonists lent to a quest. (Better Workbench Management)
